Doc: 00393b70-eb5e-4075-9348-cabfbc8ce514:icu_note
06/03/2020 11:52

ICU Admission Note

Reason for admission: Confirmed COVID-19 pneumonia with progressive hypoxemia and increasing oxygen requirement on the ward. Admitted to hospital at 00:11 on 06/03/2020, transferred to the intensive care unit at 09:09 on 06/03/2020. ICU capacity was tight but a bed was accepted without delay.

Respiratory support: Commenced on CPAP via tight-fitting mask, initial FIO2 0.6 with PEP BcmH2O. SpO2 improved from 89% to 95% following initiation. Respiratory rate settled from 32/min to 24/min after one hour of support.

Ventilation details: Non-invasive respiratory support only at present; no indication for invasive ventilation. Continuous pulse oximetry and regular arterial blood gas monitoring in place.

Organ support: No renal, cardiovascular or other organ support required at present. Cardiovasculary stable, no vasopressor requirement. Urine output satisfactory.

VTE prophylaxis: Enoxaparin first dose given 10:00 on 06/03/2020 as per critical care thromboprophylaxis protocol, no contraindication identified.

Plan: Continue CPAP with staged weaning of FIO2 as oxygenation allows. Repeat ABG in four hours. Daily bloods including inflammatory markers and renal function. Proning to be considered if oxygenation does not improve further. Discuss ceiling of care and escalation plan with family. Continue enoxaparin thromboprophylaxis and regular observations. Review by ICU consultant on morning round.
